features.name: Barcode Scanning
features.description: Enable users to scan product barcodes for quick inventory updates and lookups.
user_stories: As a store clerk, I can scan product barcodes so that I can quickly add items to inventory.
As a store manager, I can scan barcodes to verify stock levels so that I can make informed restocking decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid barcode, When the user scans it, Then the product details are displayed within 2 seconds.
Given an invalid barcode, When the user scans it, Then an error message is shown indicating the product is not found.

features.name: Real-Time Inventory Tracking
features.description: Track inventory levels in real-time as products are added, sold, or removed.
user_stories: As a store manager, I can view current inventory levels so that I know what products are in stock.
As a store clerk, I can update inventory quantities so that stock levels remain accurate.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product sale, When the transaction is completed, Then the inventory count decreases immediately.
Given multiple users updating inventory, When changes are made, Then all users see synchronized data within 3 seconds.

features.name: Low Stock Alerts
features.description: Automatically notify users when product inventory falls below defined thresholds.
user_stories: As a store manager, I can set minimum stock thresholds so that I receive alerts before running out of products.
As a store owner, I can receive notifications for low stock items so that I can reorder in time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product quantity below threshold, When inventory is updated, Then an alert is triggered immediately.
Given low stock alerts, When the manager views the dashboard, Then all low stock items are highlighted in red.

features.name: Product Management
features.description: Add, edit, and remove products with details like name, price, and category.
user_stories: As a store manager, I can add new products to the system so that they are available for inventory tracking.
As a store manager, I can edit product information so that pricing and details remain current.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid product details, When the manager submits the form, Then the product is saved to the database.
Given an existing product, When the manager updates its price, Then the new price is reflected immediately.

features.name: Sales Reporting
features.description: Generate reports showing sales trends, top-selling products, and revenue over time.
user_stories: As a store owner, I can view sales reports so that I can analyze business performance.
As a store manager, I can filter reports by date range so that I can track weekly or monthly trends.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected date range, When the user generates a report, Then sales data for that period is displayed.
Given sales data, When the report is viewed, Then top 10 selling products are listed with quantities sold.
